text:
jess-prod-support: customer on live chat says extension toolbar shows 'no request id' and their flow fails with 401. can someone paste the minimal ask for them? :eyes:

maria-support: ask for the browser-extension ReqRef first — it's in the extension menu: click the redwood icon -> "Copy ReqRef". it looks like `reqref=rc_abcdef123456` — ask them to paste that string.

alex-sre: also ask them to capture a HAR from chrome/firefox: DevTools -> Network -> right-click -> Save all as HAR. tell them to reproduce the failing request once then save. For non-devs say "Export network log (HAR)".

kundan-eng: if they can't get HAR, ask for a `Copy as cURL` of the failing request. steps:
1) open DevTools -> Network
2) filter for `api.redwood` or `generate`
3) right-click request -> Copy -> Copy as cURL
paste the curl here (remove API key or replace with <API_KEY>)

jess-prod-support: great. also ask for the SDK debug token if they're using the extension with embedded SDK. i.e. console logs often show `redwood: debug_token=dbg_XXXX` — tell them to look at browser console (F12) and copy that token.

maria-support: send this short template to customers:

``
Please include:
- Copy of the extension ReqRef (from extension menu)
- HAR file (DevTools -> Network -> Export HAR)
- OR `curl` for the failing request (Copy as cURL)
- Browser + version, extension version (Settings -> About)
- Approx local timestamp when failure happened (UTC)
- Debug token from console if present
``

alex-sre: small repro curl example (replace body/headers):
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"input":"hello"}'
```

kundan-eng: remind them to redact PII/secret prompts if needed. if they upload HAR, they can drag to our secure support upload: https://console.redwood.com/support/upload — or paste reqref + curl inline.

deploy-bot: extension v1.4.2 rolled out to stable — added clearer "Copy ReqRef" label. :shipit:

jess-prod-support: thanks all — i'll send the template now and follow up when they respond.

maria-support: tip: for Firefox extension the ReqRef is also on the popup footer (small grey text). if they send screenshot of popup it's enough for non-tech users.

alex-sre: if we get the reqref + HAR we can correlate with edge logs and pull the trace immediately. if not, request timestamps + client IP help narrow it down.
